sources.title: RIKEN invites bids for the new Fugaku NEXT computer building in Kobe
sources.summary: RIKEN invited bids on October 13, 2026 for a new building to house Fugaku NEXT at 7-1-1 Minatojima-minamimachi, Kobe. The contract covers design, construction and building maintenance through March 31, 2036. This is an announced procurement: an awarded contract, construction start and opening have not been confirmed. The notice gives no selected current power capacity or building size.

status_observation_review.basis: Exact dated public procurement names the new Fugaku NEXT building and property. Announced status only.
bidder_prior_experience_excluded: 20MW maximum electrical demand for a previously completed data center

sources.title: RIKEN publishes revised procurement after the earlier competition received no valid proposals
sources.summary: RIKEN says the earlier competition received no valid proposals by September 4, 2026, and directs bidders to the revised October 13 procurement. The project remains a new building for Fugaku NEXT. Earlier design documents and the general operation target around 2030 predate this revised competition; they do not establish its final technical requirements or opening date.

sources.title: RIKEN maps the proposed Fugaku NEXT building property south of its existing computing facilities
sources.summary: RIKEN’s October 2025 project plan identifies a separate proposed property at 7-1-1 Minatojima-minamimachi, south of the existing Fugaku facilities. Its eastern, western and southern boundaries face Minatojima Roads 44, 45 and 41. The same address appears in the October 2026 tender. The Atlas marker locates this proposed property approximately; it is not the existing Fugaku building or a confirmed footprint of the new building.
sources.date_semantics: The PDF prints October 2025; exact publication day October 15 is supplied by the original RIKEN landing page. Historical property geometry only; no physical status is inferred from old imagery.

sources.title: Earlier RIKEN requirements identify the same Kobe property and land-management arrangement
sources.summary: The August 2026 procurement version identifies the proposed site at 7-1-1 Minatojima-minamimachi and describes RIKEN as managing the land under a use loan from Kobe City. The revised October tender keeps the same address. These earlier requirements provide property history; their building size, power specifications and handover schedule are not treated as confirmed requirements of the revised competition.
sources.date_semantics: August 6 version date in the RIKEN landing-page document list and source filename; the document retains February 27 original issue date. Superseded requirements used solely for the same address and historical land-management description.

sources.title: RIKEN publishes the October 15, 2025 market-consultation plan
sources.summary: RIKEN published its public market consultation for the Fugaku NEXT building on October 15, 2025, with the project overview and property maps. This dates the historical plan used to identify the proposed property. It is separate from the revised October 2026 tender.

sources.title: GSI aerial map supporting the approximate proposed-property marker
sources.summary: GSI aerial mapping supplies a geographic reference for RIKEN’s published property outline. The marker represents the proposed parent property south of the existing Fugaku buildings. The map imagery does not establish current construction status, and the marker’s total ground accuracy is unknown.
sources.date_semantics: Tile retrieval time is not imagery acquisition or project-status date; acquisition date remains unknown.
